provenance.source: nba_api static tables (bundled with the package, no network access)
factual: NBA person ids and player names
the 30 franchises: id, name, abbreviation, city, year founded
headshotUrl, which is a deterministic function of the person id
provenance.note: Rosters change constantly and the bundled tables carry no team column, so this file states no roster. Real assignments arrive from CommonAllPlayers when the ingest worker runs with network access. Demo mode assigns teams synthetically and says so.
provenance.headshotCaveat: The CDN is unreachable from the build environment, so the pattern is unverified here. A player whose image 404s renders the monogram fallback.
